comparison.limitation: System-wide counters and file metadata cannot attribute page I/O to this volume or prove it is external. Target I/O traces and workload integrity evidence remain required.

target_io_trace.limitation: Observed trace events only; counts do not establish complete tracing or identify which allocation faulted.

provenance.interpretation_note: Original report preserved. workload_target_pageins used thread IDs as if they were PIDs and is invalid; no workload attribution is established. Target-device page I/O totals and integrity are independent of that field.
